chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام).

Regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: “So you shall come to know who it is that is in clear error” — “O assembly of the deniers, when I informed you of the message of my Lord concerning the wilayah of ʿAlī (عليه السلام) and the Imams (عليهم السلام) after him, [you shall know] who it is that is in clear error.” Thus was it revealed.

And regarding His, the Exalted, saying: “If you distort or turn away,” he said: “If you twist the matter and turn away from what you have been commanded with, then surely Allah is All-Aware of what you do.”

And regarding His saying: “So We shall most certainly make those who disbelieved taste” — by their abandoning the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام) — “a severe punishment in the world, and We shall most certainly recompense them for the worst of what they used to do.”

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: title of Imam ʿAlī (عليه السلام), the Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةِ: the Imams who succeed after Imam ʿAlī (عليهم السلام)
key_terms.تَلْوُوا: to twist, distort, or turn a matter away from its proper direction
key_terms.تُعْرِضُوا: to turn away or refuse to accept
key_terms.خَبِيرًا: fully aware and informed of all deeds
key_terms.وَلَايَةِ: authoritative guardianship and divinely mandated allegiance

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith interpret Qur'anic verses in relation to the wilayah of Imam ʿAlī (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This report presents a Qur'anic commentary linking verses about misguidance, turning away, and punishment to the rejection of the wilayah of Imam ʿAlī (عليه السلام) and the Imams (عليهم السلام) after him. It frames such rejection as clear error and as a cause of divine accountability and punishment.
